value.rationale: Field literature shows fast and delayed sediment sources and oppositely oriented figure-eight hysteresis. The exact model provides sharp source-strength bounds that are insensitive to positive rating law, a formula for the cancellation of the net signed contrast despite nonzero opposing lobes, and a constructive counterexample to inferring source order from simultaneous time peaks. These provide a motivated complete mathematical classification and benchmark for branch-aware hydrological diagnostics without overclaiming calibrated prediction.
